setupDefinitions.A_SWEEP_MSS: M15 sweeps previous 8-bar liquidity and closes back inside; within 6 M5 bars a >=0.50 ATR body closes beyond the previous 5-bar M5 swing in the reversal direction.
setupDefinitions.B_H1_PULLBACK_RECLAIM: H1 close/EMA20/EMA50 trend; latest closed M15 touches EMA20 and closes back with trend; M5 displacement closes beyond previous 5-bar swing.
setupDefinitions.C_SWEEP_FVG: M15 liquidity sweep as A, followed within 6 M5 bars by a same-direction 3-candle FVG >=0.05 M5 ATR.
setupDefinitions.D_BREAK_RETEST_CONT: H1 trend; M15 closes beyond previous 12-bar range by >=0.05 M15 ATR; within next 4 M15 bars price retests the breakout level and closes on breakout side; M5 displacement confirms continuation.
setupDefinitions.E_FAILED_BREAK_REV: M15 exceeds previous 12-bar extreme by >=0.15 ATR but closes back inside the prior range and beyond its midpoint; M5 displacement confirms reversal within 6 M5 bars.
setupDefinitions.F_IFVG_RECLAIM: A prior opposite-direction M5 FVG >=0.05 ATR is invalidated by a displacement close through the far edge; the inverted gap is the reclaim/retest zone.

protocol.selection: DEV ranks; VALIDATION gates; untouched OOS only promotes/rejects
protocol.limitFillBar: conservative: any stop touch=SL; TP counts on fill bar only if close crosses TP
